ip.meaning: IPv4 address to probe for reachability.

awake.meaning: True only if ping exits successfully and an RTT is parsed.

rtt_ms.meaning: Parsed round-trip time in milliseconds; null when the target is not observed awake.

error.meaning: Input diagnostic or ping launch error on refusal.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The stop's outcome token; none when no signal is missing.
